MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.

   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
